verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service. The docs say it deploys easily without complex dependencies on Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, Kubernetes and Raspberry Pi, in single-server or replicated setups, across multiple databases, with dynamic configuration in the admin panel. Hands-on reports corroborate this: one-binary installs, smooth Docker setup, upgrades done by swapping the binary, and low resource use. Some users report breaking changes on upgrade, one-way migrations, and maintenance overhead without dedicated DevOps staff. Missing for 10: first-party upgrade and backup/restore documentation (a user called backup/restore a possible show-stopper), and clearer upgrade-compatibility guarantees given reported breaking changes and thin docs.
